这项计划最后彻底失败了。
column2: The project ended up being a flop.
column4: 口语中用于产品、演出或商业尝试最终失败。
column5: The sequel had a huge budget but ended up being a flop.

column1: 我请人定制了这套书架。
column2: I got this bookshelf custom-made.
column4: 表示安排或付钱让别人制作，不是亲手完成。
column5: We got the invitations printed locally.

column1: 只要卖出十份，我就能收回全部投入。
column2: If I sell ten copies, I’ll make it all back.
column4: 常指收回成本或弥补先前的经济损失。
column5: The repairs were expensive, but the rental income should make it all back.

column1: 害怕犯错一直限制着我的发展。
column2: My fear of making mistakes has been holding me back.
column4: 指阻碍进步；用于自己时常强调内在障碍。
column5: Don’t let one bad review hold you back.

column1: 她一直守着自己最擅长的工作。
column2: She stuck with the work she was best at.
column4: 可以表示坚持，也可能暗示不愿离开舒适区。
column5: We decided to stick with the original plan.

column1: 他意识到自己被困在了亲手制造的限制中。
column2: He realized he was stuck in a box of his own making.
column3: be stuck in a box of one’s own making
column4: 形象地表示困境或限制主要由自己造成。
column5: The company was stuck in a box of its own making after years of rigid rules.

column1: 新领导的到来彻底打破了原来的局面。
column2: The new leader’s arrival really shook things up.
column4: 指引入变化，打破稳定甚至僵化的状态。
column5: Changing the venue could shake things up a little.

column1: 在那场聚会上什么风格都可以。
column2: At that party, anything goes.
column4: 表示限制很少、各种选择或行为都可接受。
column5: There’s no dress code here—anything goes.

column1: 我年轻时非常仰慕她。
column2: I really looked up to her when I was younger.
column4: 不仅是喜欢，还包含尊敬和视为榜样。
column5: Many junior researchers look up to their supervisor.

column1: 时间压力可能也是其中一个原因。
column2: Time pressure may have played a part in it.
column4: 承认某因素有所贡献，但不是唯一原因。
column5: Better communication played a big part in the team’s recovery.

column1: 她已经完全掌握了如何平衡速度与准确性。
column2: She has the balance between speed and accuracy down.
column4: 表示把技巧、流程或风格掌握得很牢。
column5: Once you have the basics down, the rest gets easier.

column1: 我不需要喝酒也能完全沉浸在音乐中。
column2: I don’t need to drink to lose myself in the music.
column4: 正面表示全神贯注、暂时放下自我意识。
column5: She likes to lose herself in a good novel after work.

column1: 这种习惯是我祖母传给我的。
column2: My grandmother passed this habit down to me.
column4: 常用于跨代传递物品、故事、品味或传统。
column5: The recipe has been passed down through three generations.

column1: 是我姐姐带我认识了那位作家。
column2: My sister put me onto that writer.
column3: put someone onto someone or something
column4: 非正式口语，表示推荐并带人进入一个新领域。
column5: A colleague put me onto a great podcast about design.

column1: 那次短暂的谈话却一直留在我心里。
column2: That brief conversation really stuck with me.
column4: 表示经历或话语留下持久印象。
column5: One line from the book stuck with him for years.

column1: 起初我们只是玩玩，后来决定认真做这件事。
column2: At first we were just having fun, but then we decided to do it for real.
column4: 标记态度和投入转为认真、正式，不表示之前是假的。
column5: After months of practice, she was ready to compete for real.

column1: 我花了很久才克服在公共场合讲话的恐惧。
column2: It took me a long time to get past my fear of public speaking.
column4: 表示越过障碍继续向前，不一定意味着困难彻底消失。
column5: We need to get past this disagreement and focus on the deadline.

column1: 不要害怕在会议上提出自己的想法。
column2: Don’t be afraid to put forward your ideas in the meeting.
column4: 比单纯说出更强调把想法交给他人讨论或评估。
column5: Several residents put forward practical solutions.

column1: 我终于意识到，自己才是自己最大的敌人。
column2: I finally realized that I was my own worst enemy.
column4: 表示自我怀疑、习惯或自我破坏才是最大障碍。
column5: When it comes to deadlines, he can be his own worst enemy.

column1: 她不愿为了让别人舒服而缩小自己的存在感。
column2: She refused to make herself feel small just to make other people comfortable.
column3: make oneself feel small to make others comfortable
column4: 指压低意见、能力或野心以迎合他人。
column5: You shouldn’t make yourself feel small to protect someone else’s ego.

column1: 我们因为都喜欢老电影而变得亲近。
column2: We bonded over our shared love of old films.
column4: 表示因共同兴趣、经历或困难建立亲密关系。
column5: The teammates bonded over the challenges of living abroad.
